endorsements.name: Patroklos Argyroudis
endorsements.label: Exploiting the jemalloc Memory Allocator: Owning Firefox's Heap
endorsements.description: jemalloc is a userland memory allocator that is being increasingly adopted by software projects as a high performance heap manager. It is used in Mozilla Firefox for the Windows, Mac OS X and Linux platforms, and as the default system allocator on the FreeBSD and NetBSD operating systems. Facebook also uses jemalloc in various components to handle the load of its web services. However, despite such widespread use, there is no work on the exploitation of jemalloc.
